blocks.text: Reference grammar B1

This part collects in tables what you studied in the Level B1 and continue the numbering of the cards A1 and A2 (G1–G40). It does not replace the explanations of units: it is used to review, control a form while writing and preparing tests and exams. The reference unit shall be indicated for each card. The marked forms are not required in the production of B1. The G tabs58–G60 They sum up the Egyptian track.
G41 · Root, scheme and dictionary by root (B1-01)

Find the root in five steps (G)20, extended). 1. Remove Article, Proclitic ( ⁧وَ⁩ , ⁧فَ⁩ , ⁧بِـ⁩ , ⁧لِـ⁩ , ⁧كَـ⁩ , ⁧سَـ⁩ ) and suffix pronouns. 2. Remove terminations ( ⁧ـَة⁩ , ⁧ـَات⁩ , ⁧ـُونَ⁩ , ⁧ـِينَ⁩ , ⁧ـَانِ⁩ , ⁧ـَيْنِ⁩ ). 3. Remove the verbal prefixes ( ⁧أ⁩ , ⁧ت⁩ , ⁧ي⁩ , ⁧ن⁩ ) and the added letters of the diagrams: ⁧مُـ⁩ of the parties, ⁧مَـ⁩ the place names, ⁧اِسْتَـ⁩ of form X, ⁧اِنْـ⁩ of form VII, the ⁧تَـ⁩ of V and VI, the ⁧ـتَـ⁩ of the VIII. 4. Remove the long vowels from the pattern. 5. If two consonants remain, the root is doubled, concave, defective or assimilated: try the possibilities.

G58 · Egyptian: the verb, the denial, the future (EGY-01 EGY-06)

Denial. Past and present: but...-š (ma-katabš, ma-baktibš, ma-ruḥtiš); before -š the final vowel lengthens (ma-katabūš, ma-katabtīš). Future, adjectives, nominal phrases and participles: miš (miš ḥaktib, miš ʿārif, miš hina). Negative imperative: ma-ti-...-š (ma-tiktibš, ma-truḥš). Frequent irregular verbs. rāḥ / yirūḥ "Going" šāf / yišūf See. ʾāl / yiʾūl "Say" · gih / yīgi "Coming" (imperative) taʿāla) · kal / yākul Eat • ḫad / yāḫud (e.g. take the card) ḫud). Models with simple imperfection (without b-): ʿāyiz arūḥ I want to go. lāzim timši Do you have to go to the mumkin tistanna? Can you wait?08).
